label: Rule resources (notes, links, files)
description: The Resources tab of a rule, where its owner or an admin adds Markdown notes, external links and documents. file_extensions — the only file types that can be uploaded: documents only (Markdown, text, PDF, CSV, logs), never scripts or programs; text files are always served as plain text, a PDF is checked to really be a PDF and opened by the browser's own viewer in a sandbox. max_file_kb — one text file; max_pdf_kb — one PDF; max_total_kb — all the files of one rule together; link_preview — when a link is saved, the server reads the page once to show its title, description and site name (never from a private or local address).
